SMTO-CFG-0064 — An old summary option is no longer supported

GUID: c3b1389b-d3fc-4dfe-9320-3e645c473af6
Slug: summarize-setting-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • This message comes from an older version of SMTO, which had an on/off option for a final summary. Current SMTO no longer uses that option and ignores it in new requests.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the task where this error appeared and check whether its work, such as files or changes it was making, was already done. This check ran as the task was finishing, so some or all of the work may already be complete.
  2. If you still need the result, send the request again as a new message. Current SMTO ignores the old summary option, so it won't stop a new request.

What success looks like

  • The new request finishes and shows its answer without this error.

If it still fails

  • If a brand-new request shows this error, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO; something is still sending the old option. Don't repeat work the old task already finished.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Retired compatibility diagnostic: summarize_result was supplied as a non-boolean at the direct-completion step; the switch and its validator have been removed and current request inputs drop the key.

What this means

  • summarize_result is present with a type other than an exact boolean at the direct-completion boundary. The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.

Why this can happen

  • summarize_result is present with a type other than an exact boolean at the direct-completion boundary.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the accepted summarize_result value and exact type; a string saying false is not a boolean.

How to fix it

  • No current direct-completion code raises this; it appears only on records from older builds. Current request and composer models discard summarize_result, so resubmit the work as a new request; if it appears on new work, find the caller that still sends summarize_result and remove the field.
  • Use true or false through the existing summary setting. Changing the setting applies according to its captured task scope.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A true/false value is captured through the supported summary setting.

What not to do

  • Do not change an unrelated timeout, budget or policy. Check whether the named setting applies only to a new task.

Technical notes

  • The owning policy, configuration or publication transaction validates this state. Diagnostics do not grant authority, replace accepted snapshots, execute capabilities or publish a site; preserve the exact current decision and evidence.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
